{{Quote|You are Tyro Vestara Khai, daughter of Gavar, son of Thallis.|Darish Vol, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="Omen" />}}
Thallis Khai was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Omen" /> born in the [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Time">In ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', which takes place in [[44 ABY]], Gavar Khai, Thallis Khai's son, is stated to appear to be in his early forties, slating his birth approximately around the time of the Galactic Civil War, which lasted from [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]; Thallis Khai thus must have been born several years previously, prior to the start of the war.</ref> As a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]<ref name="Omen" />&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had crash-landed on the planet in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] after being [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]] and knocked off-course during a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump in their [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the ''[[Omen]]''<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>&mdash;Thallis was a native of the remote<ref name="Omen" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Omen" />

Around the time of the Galactic Civil War,<ref name="Time" /> Khai fathered a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] son named [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]].<ref name="Omen" /> In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the flashbacks of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' to [[41 ABY]].</ref> during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Gavar's daughter Vestara Khai was brought before the Tribe's ruling council, the [[Circle of Lords]], after her encounter with the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]]. The Tribe's [[Grand Lord]], [[Darish Vol]], greeted her as the daughter of Gavar and granddaughter of Thallis.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thallis Khai was mentioned in author [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second of nine novels in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Omen" />
